```{r libraries, include=FALSE}
# Load necessary libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(emmeans)
library(multcompView)
library(forcats)

```

# **1. Load Data and Format x-Axis**
```{r load-data, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Load data
fvfm_data <- read.csv("FvFm_revised.csv")

# Format variables
fvfm_data$Seedling <- as.factor(fvfm_data$Seedling)
fvfm_data$Sterilization <- factor(
  fvfm_data$Sterilization,
  levels = c("Sterilized", "Unsterilized")
)
fvfm_data$ABA_Concentration <- as.factor(fvfm_data$ABA_Concentration)

# Clean and standardize water-treatment labels
fvfm_data$Water <- gsub("_", " ", fvfm_data$Water)

fvfm_data$Water <- dplyr::recode(
  fvfm_data$Water,
  "Moist" = "Full Water"
)

fvfm_data$Water <- factor(
  fvfm_data$Water,
  levels = c("ABA", "Full Water", "Water Limitation")
)

# Clean burn-history labels
fvfm_data$Burn_Severity <- gsub("_", " ", fvfm_data$Burn_Severity)

fvfm_data$Burn_Severity <- dplyr::case_when(
  fvfm_data$Burn_Severity == "High" ~ "High",
  fvfm_data$Burn_Severity == "Low New" ~ "Low (Initial)",
  fvfm_data$Burn_Severity == "Low Old" ~ "Low (Advanced)",
  fvfm_data$Burn_Severity == "Never" ~ "Suppressed",
  TRUE ~ NA_character_
)

fvfm_data$Burn_Severity <- factor(
  fvfm_data$Burn_Severity,
  levels = c("High", "Low (Initial)", "Low (Advanced)", "Suppressed")
)

# Remove biologically impossible outlier
fvfm_data_clean <- subset(fvfm_data, Fv_Fm > 0.1)

# Transform Fv/Fm to stabilize variance
fvfm_data_clean$Fv_Fm_asin <- asin(sqrt(fvfm_data_clean$Fv_Fm))

```

## **2. Create model**
```{r}
# Full factorial model
fvfm_model <- lm(
  Fv_Fm_asin ~ Burn_Severity * Water * Sterilization,
  data = fvfm_data_clean
)

summary(fvfm_model)

joint_tests(fvfm_model)
```


```{r}
joint_tests(fvfm_model_full) |>
  subset(`model term` == "Burn_Severity:Water:Sterilization")
```
```{r}
car::leveneTest(
  Fv_Fm_asin ~ interaction(Burn_Severity, Water, Sterilization),
  data = fvfm_data_clean
)
```
```{r}
library(sandwich)
library(lmtest)

car::Anova(
  fvfm_model_robust,
  type = 3,
  vcov. = sandwich::vcovHC(fvfm_model_robust, type = "HC3")
)

coeftest(
  fvfm_model,
  vcov. = vcovHC(fvfm_model, type = "HC3")
)


```
```{r}
fvfm_model_robust <- lm(
  Fv_Fm_asin ~ Burn_Severity * Water * Sterilization,
  data = fvfm_data_clean,
  contrasts = list(
    Burn_Severity = "contr.sum",
    Water = "contr.sum",
    Sterilization = "contr.sum"
  )
)

water_by_ster_robust <- emmeans(
  fvfm_model_robust,
  ~ Water | Sterilization,
  vcov. = sandwich::vcovHC(fvfm_model_robust, type = "HC3")
)

water_by_ster_robust

pairs(
  water_by_ster_robust,
  adjust = "tukey"
)

summary(water_by_ster_robust) %>%
  mutate(
    Fv_Fm = sin(emmean)^2,
    lower_Fv_Fm = sin(lower.CL)^2,
    upper_Fv_Fm = sin(upper.CL)^2
  )


fvfm_emm_robust <- emmeans(
  fvfm_model_robust,
  ~ Sterilization,
  vcov. = sandwich::vcovHC(fvfm_model_robust, type = "HC3")
)

pairs(fvfm_emm_robust)

car::Anova(
  fvfm_model_robust,
  type = 3,
  vcov. = sandwich::vcovHC(fvfm_model_robust, type = "HC3")
)
```
```{r}
# Transformations
fvfm_data_clean$Fv_Fm_asin <- asin(sqrt(fvfm_data_clean$Fv_Fm))

fvfm_data_clean$Fv_Fm_logit <- log(
  fvfm_data_clean$Fv_Fm / (1 - fvfm_data_clean$Fv_Fm)
)

# Same FULL hypothesis-driven model for each response scale
model_raw <- lm(
  Fv_Fm ~ Burn_Severity * Water * Sterilization,
  data = fvfm_data_clean
)

model_asin <- lm(
  Fv_Fm_asin ~ Burn_Severity * Water * Sterilization,
  data = fvfm_data_clean
)

model_logit <- lm(
  Fv_Fm_logit ~ Burn_Severity * Water * Sterilization,
  data = fvfm_data_clean
)
```

```{r}
pls205_diagnostics(model_raw)

pls205_diagnostics(model_asin)

pls205_diagnostics(model_logit)
```


## **Final model diagnostics and inference**
```{r}
# Check model assumptions
pls205_diagnostics(fvfm_model)

# Type II ANOVA
car::Anova(fvfm_model, type = 2)
```



## **3. Analyze data and calculate means**
```{r}
# Estimated marginal means
burn_means <- emmeans(fvfm_model, ~ Burn_Severity)
water_means <- emmeans(fvfm_model, ~ Water)
ster_means <- emmeans(fvfm_model, ~ Sterilization)

# Pairwise comparisons
pairs(burn_means, adjust = "tukey")
pairs(water_means, adjust = "tukey")
pairs(ster_means)

# Back-transform estimated marginal means to original Fv/Fm scale
burn_means_df <- as.data.frame(burn_means) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    FvFm_estimate = sin(emmean)^2,
    lower_FvFm = sin(lower.CL)^2,
    upper_FvFm = sin(upper.CL)^2
  )

water_means_df <- as.data.frame(water_means) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    FvFm_estimate = sin(emmean)^2,
    lower_FvFm = sin(lower.CL)^2,
    upper_FvFm = sin(upper.CL)^2
  )

ster_means_df <- as.data.frame(ster_means) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    FvFm_estimate = sin(emmean)^2,
    lower_FvFm = sin(lower.CL)^2,
    upper_FvFm = sin(upper.CL)^2
  )

burn_means_df
water_means_df
ster_means_df


```

## **4. Plot**
```{r final-fvfm-plot, fig.width=12, fig.height=7}
# Color palette
cb_palette <- c(
  "ABA" = "#E69F00",
  "Full Water" = "#56B4E9",
  "Water Limitation" = "#009E73"
)

# Plot
fvfm_plot <- ggplot(
  fvfm_data_clean,
  aes(x = Burn_Severity, y = Fv_Fm, fill = Water)
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    outlier.shape = 21,
    outlier.size = 1.5,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    shape = 21,
    color = "black",
    stroke = 0.3,
    size = 1.6,
    alpha = 0.6,
    position = position_jitterdodge(
      jitter.width = 0.2,
      dodge.width = 0.75
    )
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cb_palette) +
  facet_wrap(~ Sterilization) +
  labs(
    x = "Fire History",
    y = "Fv/Fm",
    fill = "Water Treatment"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(
    ylim = c(0.18, 0.84),
    clip = "off"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 13
    ),
    axis.text = element_text(
      size = 11
    ),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 50,
      hjust = 1,
      vjust = 1,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    legend.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 12
    ),
    legend.text = element_text(
      size = 11
    ),
    panel.border = element_rect(
      color = "black",
      fill = NA,
      linewidth = 0.8
    ),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 12
    ),
    plot.title = element_blank()
  )

fvfm_plot

```

## **5. ABA concentration analysis**
```{r}

# subset just ABA-treated seedlings
aba_data <- subset(fvfm_data_clean, Water == "ABA")

# Make sure it's a factor again
aba_data$ABA_Concentration <- droplevels(aba_data$ABA_Concentration)

# New model for ABA
aba_model <- lm(Fv_Fm_asin ~ ABA_Concentration, data = aba_data)
aba_means <- emmeans(aba_model, ~ ABA_Concentration)
pairs(aba_means, adjust = "tukey")

aba_means_df <- as.data.frame(aba_means) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    FvFm_estimate = (sin(emmean))^2,
    lower_FvFm = (sin(lower.CL))^2,
    upper_FvFm = (sin(upper.CL))^2
  )

aba_means_df
```

```{r}
anova(aba_model)
```


```{r}
# Ensure factor order
aba_data$ABA_Concentration <- factor(aba_data$ABA_Concentration, levels = c("100", "300", "500"))

# Define colors for ABA concentrations
aba_colors <- c("100" = "#66c2a5", "300" = "#fc8d62", "500" = "#8da0cb")

# Fit model
model_aba <- lm(Fv_Fm ~ ABA_Concentration, data = aba_data)

# Estimated marginal means
emm_aba <- emmeans(model_aba, ~ ABA_Concentration)

# Compact letter display
cld_aba <- multcomp::cld(emm_aba, Letters = letters, adjust = "tukey")
cld_aba$.group <- gsub(" ", "", cld_aba$.group)  # Clean up spacing

# Join letters to data
aba_data$aba_concentration <- as.factor(aba_data$ABA_Concentration)
plot_data <- left_join(aba_data, cld_aba[, c("ABA_Concentration", ".group")], by = "ABA_Concentration")

# Create plot
aba_con <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = ABA_Concentration, y = Fv_Fm, fill = ABA_Concentration)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.6, color = "black") +
  geom_jitter(
    aes(fill = ABA_Concentration),
    shape = 21,
    color = "black",
    size = 2,
    stroke = 0.4,
    width = 0.1,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = cld_aba,
    aes(x = ABA_Concentration, y = max(plot_data$Fv_Fm, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.03, label = .group),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 5,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = aba_colors) +
  labs(x = "ABA Concentration (µM)", y = "Fv/Fm") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

# Display plot
aba_con
```

```{r}
# Vector PDF
ggsave(
  filename = "ABA_FvFm_concentration.pdf",
  plot = aba_con,
  width = 12,
  height = 7,
  units = "in"
)

# 600 dpi PNG
ggsave(
  filename = "ABA_FvFm_concentration.png",
  plot = aba_con,
  width = 12,
  height = 7,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 600
)
```


## **Revised plot w/ background colors matching other plots
```{r revised-fvfm-plot, fig.width=12, fig.height=7}

# ============================================================
# Revised Fv/Fm plot
# ============================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Fire History background colors
# ------------------------------------------------------------

burn_colors_cb <- c(
  "High" = hcl(15, 75, 55),
  "Low (Initial)" = hcl(260, 60, 65),
  "Low (Advanced)" = hcl(75, 65, 75),
  "Suppressed" = hcl(330, 50, 70)
)

fire_history_bg_fvfm <- data.frame(
  Burn_Severity = factor(
    c(
      "High",
      "Low (Initial)",
      "Low (Advanced)",
      "Suppressed"
    ),
    levels = c(
      "High",
      "Low (Initial)",
      "Low (Advanced)",
      "Suppressed"
    )
  ),
  xmin = c(0.5, 1.5, 2.5, 3.5),
  xmax = c(1.5, 2.5, 3.5, 4.5)
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Grayscale Water Treatment palette
# ------------------------------------------------------------

water_colors_grey <- c(
  "ABA"              = "grey25",
  "Full Water"       = "grey55",
  "Water Limitation" = "grey85"
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Fv/Fm plot with Fire History background bands
# ------------------------------------------------------------

fvfm_plot_bg <- ggplot() +

  # Fire History background bands
  geom_rect(
    data = fire_history_bg_fvfm,
    aes(
      xmin = xmin,
      xmax = xmax,
      ymin = -Inf,
      ymax = Inf,
      fill = Burn_Severity
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    alpha = 0.60,
    color = NA
  ) +

  # Fire History fill scale
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = burn_colors_cb,
    guide = "none"
  ) +

  # Start new fill scale for Water Treatment
  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +

  # Boxplots
  geom_boxplot(
    data = fvfm_data_clean,
    aes(
      x = Burn_Severity,
      y = Fv_Fm,
      fill = Water
    ),
    outlier.shape = NA,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.6,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.75)
  ) +

  # Individual observations
  geom_point(
    data = fvfm_data_clean,
    aes(
      x = Burn_Severity,
      y = Fv_Fm,
      fill = Water,
      shape = Water,
      group = Water
    ),
    color = "black",
    stroke = 0.35,
    size = 1.8,
    alpha = 0.75,
    position = position_jitterdodge(
      jitter.width = 0.10,
      dodge.width = 0.75
    )
  ) +

  # Point shapes
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(
      "ABA"              = 21,
      "Full Water"       = 22,
      "Water Limitation" = 24
    ),
    name = "Water Treatment"
  ) +

  # Water Treatment grayscale
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = water_colors_grey,
    name = "Water Treatment"
  ) +

  # Remove white space at edges
  scale_x_discrete(
    expand = expansion(add = 0)
  ) +

  facet_wrap(~ Sterilization) +

  labs(
    x = "Fire History",
    y = expression(F[v]/F[m]),
    fill = "Water Treatment"
  ) +

  coord_cartesian(
    ylim = c(0.18, 0.85),
    clip = "off"
  ) +

  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +

  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 13
    ),

    axis.text = element_text(
      size = 11
    ),

    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 50,
      hjust = 1,
      vjust = 1,
      face = "bold"
    ),

    legend.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 12
    ),

    legend.text = element_text(
      size = 11
    ),

    panel.border = element_rect(
      color = "black",
      fill = NA,
      linewidth = 0.8
    ),

    strip.background = element_blank(),

    strip.text = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 12
    ),

    plot.title = element_blank()
  )

fvfm_plot_bg
```

## **Checking residuals**
```{r}
fvfm_data_clean$resid_full <- residuals(fvfm_model)

variance_by_cell <- fvfm_data_clean |>
  dplyr::group_by(Burn_Severity, Water, Sterilization) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n = dplyr::n(),
    residual_variance = var(resid_full),
    residual_SD = sd(resid_full),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(desc(residual_variance))

variance_by_cell
```

```{r}
fvfm_data_clean |>
  dplyr::group_by(Sterilization) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n = dplyr::n(),
    residual_variance = var(resid_full),
    residual_SD = sd(resid_full)
  )
```

##**Coefficient Table for Supplemental**
```{r}
library(sandwich)
library(lmtest)
library(flextable)
library(dplyr)

# HC3-robust coefficient tests
fvfm_ct <- lmtest::coeftest(
  fvfm_model_robust,
  vcov. = sandwich::vcovHC(fvfm_model_robust, type = "HC3")
)


# Add significance stars and format
fvfm_coef <- data.frame(
  term = rownames(fvfm_ct),
  Estimate = fvfm_ct[, 1],
  `Std. Error` = fvfm_ct[, 2],
  `t value` = fvfm_ct[, 3],
  `p value` = fvfm_ct[, 4],
  check.names = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    Significance = case_when(
      `p value` < 0.001 ~ "***",
      `p value` < 0.01  ~ "**",
      `p value` < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    ),
    Estimate = sprintf("%.4f", Estimate),
    `Std. Error` = sprintf("%.4f", `Std. Error`),
    `t value` = sprintf("%.4f", `t value`),
    `p value` = ifelse(
      `p value` < 0.001,
      "<0.001",
      sprintf("%.4f", `p value`)
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Term = term,
    Estimate,
    `Std. Error`,
    `t value`,
    `p value`,
    Significance
  )

fvfm_coef

library(flextable)

fvfm_ft <- flextable(fvfm_coef) %>%
  theme_booktabs() %>%
  font(fontname = "Times New Roman", part = "all") %>%
  fontsize(size = 12, part = "all") %>%
  autofit()

fvfm_ft

```
